paragraphs.text: A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness, with main bots, bot-to-bot messages and group chats.
# DS Bot
English | 中文
This fork integrates upstream 0.3.0 (0.3.0-rabi.3) with shared management for public Bots, Rabi assi
stant presets and deferred client loading. Private Bots require approval before native Bot tools pub
lish their content to the team. Deleted private Bots retain protected folders, memory and chats unti
l you release them in Settings. Rabi-bound Bots keep memory and learned skills under Rabi ownership;
project AGENTS.md proposals remain available. Office directory inputs reject internal links, and PN
G decoding bounds allocation and rejects truncated image data.
**Download DS Bot for Windows 10/11 (64-bit) / 下载 Windows 10/11（64 位）版**, about 212 MB / 约 212 MB. A
community project, not an official DeepSeek product. / 社区开源项目，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。
On that page, download `DS-Bot-<version>-win-x64.exe`. Double-click it to install; DS Bot opens when
it is done. No administrator rights, no Node or DSH needed. You need a DeepSeek account (you can si
gn up with a phone number on the spot) or a DeepSeek API key. DeepSeek bills by usage: see its price
s. For macOS, Linux or the DSH plugin, see Install.
在这个页面下载 `DS-Bot-<版本>-win-x64.exe`，双击就会安装，装好自动打开。不用管理员权限，不用另装 Node 或 DSH。需要一个 DeepSeek 账号（可以当场用手机号注册）
或 DeepSeek API Key。DeepSeek 按用量收费，见价格页。macOS、Linux 和 DSH 插件见安装。
The browser or Windows warns you, or blocks the installer? / 浏览器或 Windows 提示、拦下了安装包？
The installer is not signed yet, so Windows does not know its publisher.
[该节后续省略]
## Tested host and environment
This maintenance fork tests Windows x64, Node.js `24.15.0`, npm `11.12.1` and pnpm `11.28.5`, runnin
g Web from public Core source `vb2250158/deepseek-harness@c257e48b257e9688ffe18bb711b6a32c6091a863`
(`0.2.2-rc.1`). The CI runner is `windows-2025`. Earlier-host and cross-platform compatibility matri
ces are outside this target.
Windows local-agent discovery and the Codex, Claude and ACP drivers resolve npm `.cmd` shims to thei
r Node entry point and run without a shell or console window. Paths with spaces and array arguments
are preserved; cancellation and timeouts target the CLI process itself. Arbitrary `.cmd`/`.bat` scri
pts are rejected with `UNSUPPORTED_AGENT_WRAPPER`: select the executable or a Node npm entry point i
nstead. No local-agent account is signed in automatically.
Inherited environment variables whose names contain `KEY`, `TOKEN`, `SECRET` or `PASSWORD`, and DSH-
owned variables, are withheld from local agents. Explicit engine environment settings and the CLI's
own file-based sign-in remain separate.
Set `localAgentsEnabled: false` in the DS Bot plugin configuration to exclude the local-agent integr
ation in that profile. The default is `true`. Disabled profiles do not discover CLIs, register their
providers, probe versions or models, or offer local-agent approval tools. The settings page reports
the disabled state; modifying local-agent settings is refused. Saved custom agents, CLI session map
pings and Bot model references remain intact, and other Bot providers keep working. Re-enable the fi
eld to restore the integration; disabling it does not sign accounts out or move their files.
The target above is not a formal-installation claim. Loading or reindexing the team preserves existi
ng DSH Session archives, including an explicit archive with activity stopped. Opening an earlier par
t remains an explicit action that unarchives that part. See the test policy for source preparation,
behavior and saved-data regressions, Web smoke and CI scope.
[该节后续省略]
# DS Bot
The plugin list shows the DS Bot name and description in the DSH language: English, Chinese, Japanes
e, Spanish, French, German, Russian or Portuguese. The Bot interface supports English and Chinese.
`0.2.3-rabi.1` integrates the upstream 0.2.3 release, including reusable avatars, browser handoff ca
rds and stored screenshots, task-safe conversation rollover, archived-history paging, group correcti
ons and steering feedback. The Rabi workbench, team libraries, scoped-executor compatibility and def
erred client loading remain.
`0.2.0-rabi.1` integrates upstream 0.2.0: group-scoped memory, structured view cards, photos, thinki
ng levels and live turn metrics. This fork keeps equal team-management rights, independent pinned ch
ats, the native Bot panel, Rabi-owned context and memory, group libraries and interrupted-turn recov
the native Bot panel, Rabi-owned context and memory, group libraries and interrupted-turn recovery.
`0.2.0-rabi.2` retains Rabi bindings when the shared memory overlay opens and keeps the managed-memo
ry label in wide Bot details.
Restoring a Bot chat requests only that Session's metadata on paged DSH hosts. Older hosts retain th
e full catalog refresh used for navigation.
Bot chats continue interrupted turns and quota failures automatically through DSH's native continuat
ion API, without manual retry buttons or resending user messages. Repeated failures back off; new in
put, explicit stops and unloading cancel pending continuation. Unknown Rabi write outcomes are not r
eplayed. See the plugin configuration for timing options.
Group chats have Details, Library and Members tabs. Add a Bot directly below the member list. Each g
roup keeps its UTF-8 text documents in a separate folder keyed by the group ID; renaming the group k
eeps the same folder. Library supports creating, uploading and reading .md, .txt, .csv, .json and .y
aml files, with a default 1 MiB file limit. Existing names are never overwritten. Team Bots read the
se references through read_group_library. Deleting a group retains its documents.
[该节后续省略]
## Install
For this fork's host and browser clients, follow Host deployment. The instructions below install the
original upstream plugin.
**Desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux)**
[该节后续省略]
## Features
### Capabilities
Settings → **Capabilities** is a shared library of MCP servers, skills and packs. Add a capability t
o a Bot in its settings; it is available from that Bot's next message in its own chat and group chat
s. A local MCP command that a Bot adds needs your approval before it can run. Every Bot can manage s
hared capabilities; executable changes still require your approval.
